messages:
Jonah: Heads up — after the kernel rollout to 6.4.x in eu-west2 p4 pool we started seeing host instability. dmesg on multiple nodes shows: `nvidia: probe of nvidia0 failed with error -22` and repeated `nv_host: device rebind` lines. :eyes:
Maya: Confirming. ~12 hosts affected so far. Also seeing `NVRM: Xid (PCI:...): 31` and NCCL workers failing to handshake once a GPU job starts. Provisioner backlog spiking and autoscaler is thrashing.
Liam: Quick checks: can someone paste `lsmod | grep nvidia` and `journalctl -k -b | grep -i nvidia` from one bad host? Wondering if it's a module ABI mismatch.
Maya: Pasted from host eu-p4-078: `lsmod` shows no nvidia modules loaded. `journalctl` has `nvidia: Unknown symbol nvidia_probe` and `modprobe: ERROR: could not insert 'nvidia': Exec format error`.
Ops-Bot: Rolling action log — kernel 6.4.10 pushed to eu-west2-p4 (canary subset) at 1918765400, deployment succeeded on non-gpu hosts.
Liam: `Exec format error` + `Unknown symbol` smells like DKMS modules built against a different kernel-headers or a signed/unsigned module mismatch. What driver version do these images have?
Ana: The image recipe used driver 535.104 and we recently upgraded kernel packages in the base image. I suspect the image build didn't include matching kernel-headers at build time so modules weren't rebuilt correctly.
Maya: NCCL metrics from a failed job: repeated `NET/UTIL/Handshake` timeouts and `/dev/nvidiactl` flapping. Once NCCL can't handshake, the job collapses and OOM risk rises because retries keep spawning more containers.
Jonah: Workaround experiment: pinned driver to 525 on one canary host and rebooted — GPUs came up clean, NCCL handshakes succeed, workload passes. Performance is lower but stable.
Liam: Patching the entire fleet to 525 is risky (perf/cost hit). Proposal: targeted kernel rollback for p4 hosts in eu-west2 + emergency DKMS rebuild pipeline to produce proper 535 modules against the deployed 6.4 kernel.
Ana: I can trigger a DKMS rebuild job that adds `--add-removable-modules` and forces signing with our infra key. Will run on canary subset in 15m. If that fixes probe errors, we rebuild images and ship new node images.
SRE-Bot: Alert summary: 12/120 GPUs impaired in eu-west2-p4. Autoscaler paused on 6 nodes to prevent cascade.
Maya: Agreed to try DKMS rebuild canary first. If it fails, rollback plan is ready. @Ops-Bot, hold any mass kernel upgrades for other regions.
Ops-Bot: Acknowledged — kernel rollout paused globally for GPU-labeled images.
Jonah: I'll prep rollback playbook and runbook updates. Rollback snippet (pseudo):
```
# identify p4 nodes
gcloud compute instances list --filter='labels:gpu-type:p4 AND zone:eu-west2*' --format='value(name)'
# trigger image rollback (internal tooling)
infractl instances rollback --group eu-west2-p4 --target-image eu-west2-base-6.4.7
```
Keep manual approval step.
Ana: Note on costs: reverting to older drivers or lower-performing drivers will increase inference latency ~5-8% and bump GPU-hours needed. We should notify finance.
Finance-Bot: Estimated delta if we keep 525 family across eu-west2-p4: ~+$3.8k/day based on current traffic patterns.
Liam: If DKMS rebuild works, we'll need to ensure module signing keys are present in image initramfs and that `mokutil` enrolment step is baked into the image. Otherwise signed module will still reject on boot.
Maya: Running DKMS rebuild on 3 canary hosts now (1918766200). Will report back in 30m. Standby @Jonah @Liam for rollback depending on outcome. :thumbsup:
